cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Orders from the Shadows
cards.instruction: Hide that you set the problem in motion while quietly directing how everyone responds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The crates went to Leeds. Send the driver to me; I'll sort it quietly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your email says Leeds. Shall I forward it to the manager?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Forward my corrected address instead. She needs the destination, not the correspondence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She wants a timeline before approving another van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with when we discovered the error. I'll arrange the van while you write.

mechanism: A uses professional recovery and reporting distinctions to direct a shipping correction while suppressing the email that proves A caused the error.
confusable: D63 hides truth to preserve a power balance; D61 specifically conceals A own initiating role while managing others response.
comparison: Wedding alternative avoids an automatic cancellation attribution; crates alternative curates the written timeline and address evidence.
seedUse: Leeds shipment, A email, manager timeline and new van derive from D61-a; S03 adds exact recovery-versus-correspondence corrections.
